words.enDefinition: the main student building for clubs, events, and services

examples.en: The student union is open until midnight, so club meetings run late.
examples.zh: 「学生会馆」开放到午夜，所以社团活动经常开到很晚。

examples.en: You can buy discounted movie tickets at the student union front counter.
examples.zh: 你可以在「学生会馆」前台买到打折的电影票。

collocations: hang out in the student union

words.enDefinition: a building housing many student support offices under one roof

examples.en: Everything from counseling to tutoring is booked through the student services center.
examples.zh: 从心理咨询到学业辅导，都要通过「学生服务中心」预约。

examples.en: New students should visit the student services center during orientation week.
examples.zh: 新生应该在迎新周去一趟「学生服务中心」。

collocations: located in the student services center

words.enDefinition: the university office responsible for student life outside classes

examples.en: Housing questions go to student affairs, not to your academic department.
examples.zh: 住宿方面的问题要找「学生事务」部门，而不是你的院系。

examples.en: She works in student affairs and helps organize campus events.
examples.zh: 她在「学生事务」部门工作，帮忙组织校园活动。

words.enDefinition: a single office where students handle many errands together

examples.en: The new help hub is a one-stop shop for enrollment and ID questions.
examples.zh: 新的办事大厅是处理注册和证件问题的「一站式服务点」。

examples.en: Students like the center because it is a one-stop shop for paperwork.
examples.zh: 同学们都喜欢这个中心，因为办各种手续它是「一站式服务点」。

collocations: a one-stop shop for student services
turn the office into a one-stop shop

words.enDefinition: the campus office offering guidance about majors and future work

examples.en: Book a session at the career center to explore your options.
examples.zh: 在「就业指导中心」预约一次咨询，探索一下自己的方向。

examples.en: The career center offers free advising, not just job listings.
examples.zh: 「就业指导中心」提供免费咨询，并不只是发布招聘信息。

collocations: an appointment at the career center

words.enDefinition: a staff member who helps students plan their career direction

examples.en: My career counselor suggested I try two different summer internships.
examples.zh: 「职业规划顾问」建议我试两个不同的暑期实习。

examples.en: Talk to a career counselor before you switch your major.
examples.zh: 换专业之前，先和「职业规划顾问」聊一聊。

words.enDefinition: one-on-one guidance sessions about majors and career paths

examples.en: Career advising is free for all students during exam season too.
examples.zh: 考试季期间，「职业规划咨询」对全体学生同样免费。

examples.en: I signed up for career advising to plan my next steps.
examples.zh: 我报名了「职业规划咨询」，规划接下来的路怎么走。

words.enDefinition: the campus office where students can talk with counselors

examples.en: The counseling center offers free sessions for all enrolled students.
examples.zh: 「心理咨询中心」为所有在校学生提供免费咨询。

examples.en: Walk into the counseling center if you need to talk to someone today.
examples.zh: 如果今天就想找人聊聊，可以直接走进「心理咨询中心」。

collocations: refer a student to the counseling center

words.enDefinition: a scheduled one-on-one session with a campus counselor

examples.en: I booked a counseling appointment for Thursday afternoon after my last class.
examples.zh: 我把「心理咨询预约」约在周四下午最后一节课之后。

examples.en: Cancel your counseling appointment online if something unexpected comes up.
examples.zh: 如果临时有事，就上网取消「心理咨询预约」。

words.enDefinition: counseling sessions with several students and one counselor together

examples.en: Group counseling helped me realize other students feel the same way.
examples.zh: 「团体心理辅导」让我意识到其他同学也有同样的感受。

examples.en: The counseling center runs group counseling for homesick first-year students.
examples.zh: 咨询中心为想家的大一新生开设了「团体心理辅导」。

words.enDefinition: a short first counseling chat without any prior booking

examples.en: No booking needed; the counseling center holds walk-in consultations every afternoon.
examples.zh: 无需预约，咨询中心每天下午都有「免预约咨询」。

examples.en: I tried a walk-in consultation first before committing to weekly sessions.
examples.zh: 我先试了一次「免预约咨询」，再决定要不要每周固定咨询。

words.enDefinition: a phone service for students in urgent emotional distress

examples.en: Save the counseling center's crisis line number in your phone.
examples.zh: 把咨询中心的「心理危机热线」号码存进手机里。

examples.en: The crisis line is answered around the clock during exam weeks.
examples.zh: 考试周期间，「心理危机热线」全天都有人接听。

words.enDefinition: an official recommendation sending a student to another service

examples.en: The nurse gave me a referral to a physiotherapist off campus.
examples.zh: 护士给我开了「转介单」，推荐我去校外的物理治疗师那里。

examples.en: Ask the front desk for a referral if you need long-term counseling.
examples.zh: 如果你需要长期咨询，请向前台索要「转介」。

words.enDefinition: the campus clinic where students see doctors and nurses

examples.en: The health center can see you today if you arrive before noon.
examples.zh: 中午前赶到「校医院」的话，今天就能看上病。

examples.en: Bring your student ID and insurance card to the health center.
examples.zh: 去「校医院」记得带上学生证和保险卡。

collocations: an appointment at the health center

words.enDefinition: a clinic service that treats patients without appointments

examples.en: The health center runs a walk-in clinic for minor illnesses.
examples.zh: 校医院设有处理小毛病的「免预约门诊」。

examples.en: I used the walk-in clinic when my sore throat got worse.
examples.zh: 嗓子疼加重的时候，我去看了「免预约门诊」。

words.enDefinition: a booking made for later on the same day

examples.en: Call at 8 a.m. if you want a same-day appointment.
examples.zh: 想约「当日预约」的话，早上八点就打电话。

examples.en: Same-day appointments at the health center go quickly in flu season.
examples.zh: 流感季校医院的「当日预约」很快就约满了。

words.enDefinition: the dedicated phone number for booking clinic visits

examples.en: Save the health center's appointment line number in your contacts.
examples.zh: 把校医院的「预约专线」存进通讯录。

examples.en: The appointment line opens at eight and is busy all morning.
examples.zh: 「预约专线」八点开通，整个上午都很占线。

words.enDefinition: a self-service touchscreen used to announce your arrival

examples.en: Use the check-in kiosk by scanning your student ID card.
examples.zh: 在「自助签到机」上刷一下学生证就能签到。

examples.en: The check-in kiosk prints a ticket with your wait time.
examples.zh: 「自助签到机」会打出一张显示等候时间的单子。

collocations: scan your ID at the kiosk

words.enDefinition: a staffed window for submitting forms and picking up items

examples.en: Take your form to the service counter on the second floor.
examples.zh: 把表格拿到二楼的「服务柜台」。

examples.en: The service counter closes at four, so come before your afternoon class.
examples.zh: 「服务柜台」四点关门，要赶在下午上课前过去。

words.enDefinition: pull a paper ticket to hold your place in line

examples.en: Take a number at the entrance and wait to be called.
examples.zh: 在入口处「取号」，然后等叫号。

examples.en: You need to take a number even for quick questions.
examples.zh: 就算是简单问题，也要先「取号」。

collocations: take a number from the dispenser

words.enDefinition: the time spent waiting before you are served

examples.en: The wait time at the ID office is shortest on Friday mornings.
examples.zh: 周五早上补证办公室的「等候时间」最短。

examples.en: Check the website for current wait times before you walk over.
examples.zh: 过去之前，先上网查一下当前的「等候时间」。

words.enDefinition: a line of people waiting to be served

examples.en: There was a long queue outside the registrar's office this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上教务处门口「排队」的人特别多。

examples.en: Join the queue early because the counter opens at nine sharp.
examples.zh: 柜台九点整开门，所以要早点来「排队」。

collocations: at the front of the queue

words.enDefinition: the staff member who processes requests at a counter

examples.en: The front desk clerk scanned my ID and handed me my package.
examples.zh: 「前台职员」扫了一下我的证件，把包裹递给了我。

examples.en: Ask the front desk clerk to note your new phone number.
examples.zh: 请「前台职员」把你的新电话号码记下来。

collocations: the front desk clerk on duty
show your ID to the clerk

words.enDefinition: Enter a digital waiting line for a service that attends to people in turn.

examples.en: You can join a virtual queue for the advising desk before you walk over from class.
examples.zh: 你可以下课后还没走到咨询台时，就先「加入线上等候队列」。

examples.en: I had to join a virtual queue to speak with someone at the student service centre.
examples.zh: 我要先「加入线上等候队列」，才能和学生服务中心的工作人员说上话。

collocations: join a virtual queue for advising
use a link to join a virtual queue

words.enDefinition: give up your booked time slot ahead of the visit

examples.en: Cancel your appointment online if your class schedule suddenly changes.
examples.zh: 如果课表有变动，就在网上「取消预约」。

examples.en: Please cancel an appointment you cannot attend so someone else can use it.
examples.zh: 去不了的预约请及时「取消预约」，把时段让给其他同学。

words.enDefinition: an automatic email or text sent before your booked time

examples.en: I set an appointment reminder so I never miss tutoring.
examples.zh: 我设置了「预约提醒」，这样就不会错过辅导。

examples.en: The system sends an appointment reminder the day before each visit.
examples.zh: 系统会在前一天发送「预约提醒」。

words.enDefinition: fixed hours when staff see students without any booking

examples.en: The advisor's walk-in hours are Tuesdays and Thursdays from two to four.
examples.zh: 顾问的「免预约时段」是周二和周四下午两点到四点。

examples.en: During walk-in hours, no appointment is needed for quick questions.
examples.zh: 在「免预约时段」，问简单问题不需要预约。

words.enDefinition: a campus office offering free course help from student tutors

examples.en: The academic tutoring center pairs you with a student who aced the course.
examples.zh: 「学术辅导中心」会给你安排一位这门课考得很好的同学。

examples.en: Sessions at the academic tutoring center are free up to two hours a week.
examples.zh: 「学术辅导中心」的辅导每周免费两小时。

collocations: sign up at the tutoring center

words.enDefinition: a student who tutors classmates in courses they excelled in

examples.en: My peer tutor explained integration step by step until it clicked.
examples.zh: 「同伴辅导员」一步步给我讲积分，直到我恍然大悟。

examples.en: Peer tutors are students who earned an A in the same course.
examples.zh: 「同伴辅导员」都是同一门课拿过A的同学。

words.enDefinition: a drop-in room where tutors help with math problems

examples.en: Drop by the math lab any time before the homework deadline.
examples.zh: 作业截止前，随时可以去「数学辅导室」。

examples.en: The math lab is busiest the night before problem sets are due.
examples.zh: 习题集截止前一晚，「数学辅导室」人最多。

collocations: visit the math lab before the deadline

words.enDefinition: a booked session with a tutor for one course

examples.en: I booked a tutoring appointment for Wednesday to go over my chemistry notes.
examples.zh: 我的「辅导预约」约在周三，一起过一遍化学笔记。

examples.en: Cancel your tutoring appointment if you cannot make it, or you lose priority.
examples.zh: 去不了就取消「辅导预约」，否则会失去优先排课资格。

words.enDefinition: private tutoring sessions with a single tutor and student

examples.en: One-on-one tutoring for statistics is available on weekday evenings this term.
examples.zh: 统计学的「一对一辅导」安排在工作日晚上。

examples.en: Sign up for one-on-one tutoring if group sessions move too fast.
examples.zh: 如果小组课进度太快，就报名「一对一辅导」。

words.enDefinition: drop-in tutoring focused on current problem sets and assignments

examples.en: Homework help runs every weekday evening in the learning commons.
examples.zh: 每个工作日晚上，学习共享空间都有「作业辅导」。

examples.en: Bring your problem set to homework help and work through it with a tutor.
examples.zh: 带上习题集去「作业辅导」，和辅导员一起把它做出来。

words.enDefinition: a short class teaching effective reading, memory, and revision techniques

examples.en: The study skills workshop covers active recall and spaced repetition.
examples.zh: 「学习技巧工作坊」会讲主动回忆和间隔重复这些方法。

examples.en: I attended a study skills workshop right before midterms started.
examples.zh: 期中考开始前，我参加了一次「学习技巧工作坊」。

collocations: sign up for the study skills workshop

words.enDefinition: a short class on planning weekly schedules and deadlines

examples.en: The time management workshop shows you how to plan a weekly schedule.
examples.zh: 「时间管理工作坊」教你怎样安排每周的日程。

examples.en: Sign up for the time management workshop through the services portal.
examples.zh: 通过服务门户报名「时间管理工作坊」。

collocations: register for the time management workshop

words.enDefinition: a group session on planning and pacing revision before exams

examples.en: The learning center offers an exam prep workshop before every midterm season.
examples.zh: 学习中心每逢期中考前都会开设「备考工作坊」。

examples.en: The exam prep workshop taught me how to make a revision plan.
examples.zh: 「备考工作坊」教会了我怎样制定复习计划。

collocations: an exam prep workshop before finals

words.enDefinition: a staff advisor who helps students build effective study habits

examples.en: My academic coach helped me build a realistic weekly study plan.
examples.zh: 「学业教练」帮我制定了一份切实可行的每周学习计划。

examples.en: Academic coaches meet you weekly to check your progress and goals.
examples.zh: 「学业教练」每周和你见面，跟进你的进展。

words.enDefinition: a program pairing students to teach each other their languages

examples.en: The language exchange pairs students who want to practice each other's languages.
examples.zh: 「语言交换」把想练对方母语的同学两两配对。

examples.en: I found a language exchange partner who wants to learn Mandarin.
examples.zh: 我找了一位想学中文的「语言交换」伙伴。

words.enDefinition: a student who practices casual speaking with you regularly

examples.en: Sign up online to get a conversation partner for English practice.
examples.zh: 在网上报名，就能配到一位练英语的「会话伙伴」。

examples.en: My conversation partner and I meet at the café every Friday.
examples.zh: 我和「会话伙伴」每周五在咖啡馆碰面。

words.enDefinition: individual sessions improving how English sounds to listeners

examples.en: Pronunciation coaching sessions focus on the sounds you find hardest.
examples.zh: 「发音辅导」课专门攻克你觉得最难发的音。

examples.en: Book pronunciation coaching at the language center before your presentation.
examples.zh: 做演讲之前，先到语言中心预约「发音辅导」。

words.enDefinition: peer-led group study sessions attached to difficult courses

examples.en: Supplemental instruction sessions for organic chemistry run twice a week.
examples.zh: 有机化学的「同伴导修课」每周上两次。

examples.en: Students who attend supplemental instruction regularly tend to score higher.
examples.zh: 坚持上「同伴导修课」的学生，成绩往往更高。

words.enDefinition: the office arranging academic supports for students with disabilities

examples.en: Register with disability services before the semester starts to arrange support.
examples.zh: 学期开始前，先到「残障学生服务处」登记以便安排支持。

examples.en: Disability services arranges note-takers and extended time for all exams.
examples.zh: 「残障学生服务处」会安排笔记协助和延长考试时间。

words.enDefinition: an official letter listing supports each professor must provide

examples.en: Send your accommodation letter to professors in the first week.
examples.zh: 开学第一周就要把「合理便利通知信」发给各位教授。

examples.en: My accommodation letter lists extended time and a quiet exam room.
examples.zh: 我的「合理便利通知信」列明了延长考试时间和独立安静考场。

words.enDefinition: a formal application for academic supports based on disability

examples.en: Submit your accommodation request with documentation from a licensed doctor.
examples.zh: 提交「便利安排申请」时要附上医生出具的证明。

examples.en: My accommodation request took almost two weeks to get approved.
examples.zh: 我的「便利安排申请」大约过了两周才批下来。

words.enDefinition: extra minutes on timed exams, usually fifty percent more

examples.en: With extended time, I get fifty percent more minutes on exams.
examples.zh: 有了「延长考试时间」，我考试可以多用一半的时间。

examples.en: Extended time must be arranged before the exam schedule is posted.
examples.zh: 「延长考试时间」必须在考试安排公布前办好。

words.enDefinition: an approved exam arrangement such as extra time or separate rooms

examples.en: My exam accommodation includes a separate room and extra time.
examples.zh: 我的「考试便利安排」包括独立考场和延长时间。

examples.en: Book your exam accommodation at least two weeks before each test.
examples.zh: 每场考试至少提前两周预订「考试便利安排」。

words.enDefinition: the office that supervises exams for students with accommodations

examples.en: Students with approved accommodations take their exams at the testing center.
examples.zh: 有便利安排的学生在「考试服务中心」参加考试。

examples.en: Reserve a seat at the testing center for each scheduled exam.
examples.zh: 每场排定的考试都要在「考试服务中心」预订座位。

collocations: take an exam at the testing center

words.enDefinition: software and devices that help students read, write, and organize

examples.en: Assistive technology like screen readers is available in the library lab.
examples.zh: 图书馆机房提供屏幕阅读器等「辅助技术」。

examples.en: Ask disability services for free training on assistive technology software.
examples.zh: 可以向残障学生服务处申请「辅助技术」软件的免费培训。

words.enDefinition: course materials provided as audio, large print, or digital text

examples.en: Request your textbooks in an alternate format before classes begin.
examples.zh: 开课之前就申请「替代格式」的教材。

examples.en: The office converts readings into alternate formats like audio files.
examples.zh: 该办公室会把阅读材料转换成音频文件等「替代格式」。

words.enDefinition: sign language interpreters arranged for lectures and campus meetings

examples.en: Interpreter services must be requested at least a week ahead.
examples.zh: 「手语翻译服务」至少要提前一周申请。

examples.en: Interpreter services covered my weekly lab sessions all semester long.
examples.zh: 整个学期的每周实验课都由「手语翻译服务」提供支持。

words.enDefinition: real-time or recorded subtitles added to lectures and videos

examples.en: Live captioning is available for lectures if you request it.
examples.zh: 只要提出申请，听课就能享受实时「字幕服务」。

examples.en: Recorded lectures include captioning, which helps when the accent is unfamiliar.
examples.zh: 录播课自带「字幕」，口音听不惯的时候很有帮助。

words.enDefinition: a step-free building entry for wheelchair and mobility users

examples.en: The accessible entrance is on the north side of the building.
examples.zh: 「无障碍入口」在大楼北侧。

examples.en: Ask campus security to unlock the accessible entrance after hours.
examples.zh: 非开放时段可以请校园保安打开「无障碍入口」。

words.enDefinition: reserved parking spaces near buildings for drivers with disabilities

examples.en: Accessible parking near the science building requires a special permit.
examples.zh: 科学楼附近的「无障碍停车位」需要专用许可证。

examples.en: Apply for accessible parking through the disability services office online.
examples.zh: 通过残障学生服务处申请「无障碍停车位」。

words.enDefinition: a trained animal allowed everywhere to assist a disabled student

examples.en: Service animals are allowed inside classrooms and the dining hall.
examples.zh: 「服务犬」可以带进教室和食堂。

examples.en: Register your service animal with the disability services office before move-in.
examples.zh: 入住宿舍前，先在残障学生服务处登记你的「服务犬」。

words.enDefinition: a staff member helping international students with campus questions

examples.en: The international student advisor answered my questions about course loads.
examples.zh: 「国际学生顾问」解答了我关于课程学分量的疑问。

examples.en: See the international student advisor before you travel home for the holidays.
examples.zh: 假期回国之前，先去见一下「国际学生顾问」。

words.enDefinition: a welcome program covering banking, phones, and campus services

examples.en: International student orientation covers banking, phones, insurance, and campus services.
examples.zh: 「国际学生迎新」会讲银行开户、办手机卡和校园服务。

examples.en: I made my first real friends at international student orientation.
examples.zh: 我第一批真正的朋友就是在「国际学生迎新」上认识的。

words.enDefinition: advising appointments about keeping legal student status documents current

examples.en: Immigration advising appointments are booked through the international office portal.
examples.zh: 「移民事务咨询」要通过国际学生办公室的门户预约。

examples.en: Check with immigration advising before working more hours on campus.
examples.zh: 校内工作想增加时长之前，先找「移民事务咨询」问清楚。

words.enDefinition: a program matching new international students with local students

examples.en: The buddy program matched me with a senior who showed me around.
examples.zh: 「结对互助项目」给我匹配了一位带我熟悉校园的高年级学长。

examples.en: Sign up for the buddy program when you accept your offer.
examples.zh: 接受录取后，就可以报名「结对互助项目」。

collocations: sign up for the buddy program

words.enDefinition: the packed first week of campus events for incoming students

examples.en: Orientation week is packed with campus tours and info booths.
examples.zh: 「迎新周」里到处都是校园参观和信息咨询台。

examples.en: Get your ID card sorted during orientation week before classes start.
examples.zh: 趁上课前，在「迎新周」把学生证办好。

words.enDefinition: the official welcome program that introduces campus services and expectations

examples.en: New student orientation ends with a fair where every office has a booth.
examples.zh: 「新生迎新活动」以一场各部门摆摊的展会收尾。

examples.en: Missing new student orientation means registering for courses on your own.
examples.zh: 错过「新生迎新活动」，选课就只能靠自己摸索了。

collocations: a session at new student orientation

words.enDefinition: a trained student who guides new students during orientation

examples.en: Our orientation leader showed us the shortcut to the science building.
examples.zh: 我们的「迎新学长」带我们走了去科学楼的近路。

examples.en: Orientation leaders answer any question, from dining plans to bus routes.
examples.zh: 从餐饮套餐到公交路线，「迎新学长」什么问题都会耐心解答。

collocations: apply to be an orientation leader

words.enDefinition: a scheduled meeting explaining one aspect of starting university

examples.en: Each orientation session lasts about an hour and ends with questions.
examples.zh: 每场「迎新说明会」约一小时，最后留有提问时间。

examples.en: Attendance at the first orientation session is required for all new students.
examples.zh: 所有新生都必须参加第一场「迎新说明会」。

collocations: sign up for an orientation session

words.enDefinition: a walk around campus that shows main buildings and services

examples.en: The campus tour ends at the student union, where lunch is provided.
examples.zh: 「校园参观」的终点是学生会馆，那里提供午餐。

examples.en: Book a campus tour online before you arrive for orientation.
examples.zh: 来参加迎新前，先在网上预约「校园参观」。

words.enDefinition: a campus walk led by someone who explains each stop

examples.en: The guided tour covers the library, the gym, and the health center.
examples.zh: 「有讲解的参观」会带你走图书馆、体育馆和校医院。

examples.en: Choose the guided tour if you want to ask questions along the way.
examples.zh: 想随时提问的话，就选「有讲解的参观」。

words.enDefinition: a campus walk you complete alone using a printed map

examples.en: Grab a map from the booth and do the self-guided tour.
examples.zh: 在展台拿一张地图，自己完成「自助参观」。

examples.en: The self-guided tour takes about forty minutes at a relaxed pace.
examples.zh: 「自助参观」放慢脚步走大约四十分钟。

words.enDefinition: a student who leads campus visits and answers questions

examples.en: Our tour guide was a junior who knew every building's history.
examples.zh: 我们的「参观向导」是大三学生，知道每栋楼的历史。

examples.en: The tour guide kept the group together near the busy crosswalk.
examples.zh: 在繁忙的路口，「参观向导」把队伍重新聚拢起来。

words.enDefinition: a small outdoor table where volunteers answer newcomer questions

examples.en: Stop by the info booth in the quad for a free campus map.
examples.zh: 到广场上的「信息咨询台」领一张免费校园地图。

examples.en: Volunteers at the info booth answered all my orientation week questions.
examples.zh: 「信息咨询台」的志愿者解答了我迎新周的所有疑问。

collocations: an info booth on the quad

words.enDefinition: a short presentation introducing one program or office

examples.en: The exchange program info session is on Wednesday at five.
examples.zh: 交换项目的「信息说明会」定在周三五点。

examples.en: Every office holds at least one info session during orientation week.
examples.zh: 迎新周期间，每个部门都会办一场「信息说明会」。

collocations: an info session about exchange programs

words.enDefinition: the front table where attendees sign in and collect materials

examples.en: Pick up your name tag at the check-in table by the main gate.
examples.zh: 在大门口的「签到台」领取你的名牌。

examples.en: The check-in table opens an hour before the first session.
examples.zh: 「签到台」在第一场活动开始前一小时开放。

collocations: sign in at the check-in table

words.enDefinition: a printed or digital map marking every campus building

examples.en: The campus map on the app shows accessible entrances too.
examples.zh: 应用里的「校园地图」也标出了无障碍入口。

examples.en: Circle your classrooms on the campus map before the first week.
examples.zh: 开学第一周前，先在「校园地图」上圈出你要去的教室。

collocations: mark buildings on the campus map

words.enDefinition: a sticker or badge showing your name at events

examples.en: Wear your name tag all week so people know what to call you.
examples.zh: 整周都戴着「名牌」，这样大家知道该怎么称呼你。

examples.en: I wrote my preferred name on the name tag in marker.
examples.zh: 我用马克笔在「名牌」上写下了自己惯用的名字。

collocations: write your name on the name tag

words.enDefinition: a small gift bag of samples, coupons, and campus items

examples.en: Each goodie bag contained a water bottle, coupons, and a planner.
examples.zh: 每个「礼品袋」里都装着水壶、优惠券和一本日程本。

examples.en: Grab a goodie bag at the welcome booth before they run out.
examples.zh: 快去迎新展台领「礼品袋」，晚了就发完了。

words.enDefinition: an event where every student office hosts an information table

examples.en: The resource fair gathers every student office in one big hall.
examples.zh: 「资源展会」把所有学生服务机构都聚在一个大厅里。

examples.en: I collected tutoring and shuttle schedules at the resource fair.
examples.zh: 我在「资源展会」上拿到了辅导班和班车的时刻表。

words.enDefinition: reissuing a student card after it is lost or broken

examples.en: ID replacement costs twenty dollars if you lose your card twice.
examples.zh: 学生证丢第二次的话，「学生证补办」要收二十美元。

examples.en: Go to the campus services office for an ID replacement.
examples.zh: 要「补办学生证」，就去校园服务办公室。

words.enDefinition: the photo printed on your student card at issuance

examples.en: The ID photo is taken on the spot at the card office.
examples.zh: 「证件照」在制卡办公室当场拍摄。

examples.en: Wear plain colors for your ID photo; the background is white.
examples.zh: 拍「证件照」要穿素色衣服，背景是白色的。

words.enDefinition: turning on a new student card's building and payment functions

examples.en: Card activation happens automatically once you are officially enrolled for the term.
examples.zh: 正式注册本学期学籍后，「卡片激活」会自动完成。

examples.en: If card activation fails, bring your passport to the services desk.
examples.zh: 如果「卡片激活」失败，请带着护照到服务台处理。

words.enDefinition: building entry granted by tapping your student card at doors

examples.en: Swipe access to the lab is activated after your safety training.
examples.zh: 完成安全培训后，实验室的「刷卡通行」才会开通。

examples.en: My swipe access stopped working, so I asked the desk to reset it.
examples.zh: 我的「刷卡通行」失灵了，就请服务台帮我重置。

words.enDefinition: a free bus loop connecting dorms, campuses, and stations

examples.en: The free shuttle service runs every ten minutes between campuses.
examples.zh: 免费「班车服务」每十分钟往返校区一趟。

examples.en: The shuttle service adds extra late-night routes during exam weeks.
examples.zh: 考试周期间，「班车服务」会增开深夜班次。

words.enDefinition: a marked bus stop where campus shuttles pick up passengers

examples.en: The nearest shuttle stop to the dorm is by the north gate.
examples.zh: 离宿舍最近的「班车站」在北门旁边。

examples.en: Check the app for live departure times at each shuttle stop.
examples.zh: 在应用上查看每个「班车站」的实时发车时间。

words.enDefinition: the fixed path a campus bus follows between stops

examples.en: The shuttle route covers the dorms, the gym, and the main quad.
examples.zh: 这条「班车路线」覆盖宿舍、体育馆和主广场。

examples.en: They added a weekend shuttle route to the shopping district.
examples.zh: 学校新增了一条开往商业区的周末「班车路线」。

words.enDefinition: the timetable listing departure times for every campus bus

examples.en: The shuttle schedule always changes during summer and winter breaks.
examples.zh: 暑假和寒假期间，「班车时刻表」会有调整。

examples.en: Screenshot the shuttle schedule because not every stop posts departure times.
examples.zh: 截图存下「班车时刻表」，因为不是每个站都张贴班次。

words.enDefinition: a live map showing where each campus bus currently is

examples.en: The shuttle tracker shows the next bus arriving in four minutes.
examples.zh: 「班车实时追踪」显示下一班车四分钟后到站。

examples.en: Check the shuttle tracker before you walk to the stop in the rain.
examples.zh: 下雨天走去车站前，先看一下「班车实时追踪」。

words.enDefinition: travel between campus locations on the free university bus

examples.en: I ride the shuttle to the north campus for my lab twice a week.
examples.zh: 我每周两次「乘坐班车」去北校区上实验课。

examples.en: Students ride the shuttle free with a valid student ID.
examples.zh: 出示有效学生证，就能免费「乘坐班车」。

words.enDefinition: late-night bus loops that run until around midnight

examples.en: The evening shuttle runs until midnight from the library steps.
examples.zh: 「夜间班车」从图书馆台阶前一直运营到午夜。

examples.en: Take the evening shuttle if your study session runs late.
examples.zh: 自习到很晚的话，就坐「夜间班车」回去。

words.enDefinition: a bus linking two separate campuses on a fixed timetable

examples.en: The intercampus shuttle takes forty minutes between the two campuses.
examples.zh: 「校际班车」在两个校区之间要开四十分钟。

examples.en: Book a seat on the intercampus shuttle during exam week; it fills fast.
examples.zh: 考试周「校际班车」很快就满座，记得提前订位。

collocations: reserve a seat on the intercampus shuttle

words.enDefinition: a prepaid card letting students ride city public transport

examples.en: Your student transit pass covers city buses and the light rail.
examples.zh: 学生「公交通行卡」可以坐市内公交和轻轨。

examples.en: Pick up your transit pass at the services center with your ID.
examples.zh: 带上证件，到服务中心领取「公交通行卡」。

words.enDefinition: a reduced public transport fare offered to students

examples.en: Show your student card to get the transit discount on buses.
examples.zh: 坐公交时出示学生证，就能享受「交通优惠」。

examples.en: The transit discount applies to monthly passes, not single tickets.
examples.zh: 「交通优惠」只适用于月票，不包括单程票。

words.enDefinition: a staff walk-along service for students traveling at night

examples.en: Call campus security for a safety escort if you leave the library late.
examples.zh: 晚上离开图书馆太晚时，可以叫校园保安提供「安全护送」。

examples.en: The safety escort service walks students to dorms until 2 a.m.
examples.zh: 「安全护送服务」凌晨两点前都会陪学生走回宿舍。

words.enDefinition: pay for a personal storage locker for a fixed period

examples.en: Rent a locker at the gym desk for the whole semester.
examples.zh: 在体育馆前台「租储物柜」，可以租一整个学期。

examples.en: You can rent a locker in the science building for lab coats.
examples.zh: 你可以在科学楼「租储物柜」来放实验服。

collocations: rent a locker for the semester
rent a locker at the gym
rent a locker near your classes

words.enDefinition: the rental charge for using a storage locker

examples.en: The locker fee is ten dollars per month, payable online.
examples.zh: 「储物柜租金」每月十美元，可以在线支付。

examples.en: The locker fee is non-refundable once the semester officially starts.
examples.zh: 学期一开始，「储物柜租金」就不予退还。

words.enDefinition: the specific locker number allocated to you when renting

examples.en: Your locker assignment will be emailed within two business days.
examples.zh: 「储物柜分配」结果会在两个工作日内邮件通知你。

examples.en: Check your locker assignment number before you buy a padlock.
examples.zh: 买挂锁之前，先确认你的「储物柜分配」。

words.enDefinition: collect your lost property from the lost and found office

examples.en: You can claim a lost item at the campus services desk with your ID.
examples.zh: 带上证件，就可以在校园服务台「认领失物」。

examples.en: I went to the desk first thing in the morning to claim a lost item.
examples.zh: 我一大早就赶到服务台「认领失物」。

collocations: claim a lost item in person
claim a lost item within thirty days

words.enDefinition: notify the office that something of yours went missing

examples.en: Report a lost item online and the office will email you if it turns up.
examples.zh: 在网上「申报失物」，一旦有人捡到，办公室会邮件通知你。

examples.en: Report a lost item right away and include any serial numbers.
examples.zh: 丢失物品后要立刻「申报失物」，并附上序列号。

collocations: report a lost item to security
the form to report a lost item

words.enDefinition: hand something you found to staff so the owner can collect

examples.en: Please turn in a found item at the front desk of any campus building.
examples.zh: 捡到别人的东西，请到任何一栋楼的前台「上交拾获物品」。

examples.en: Turn in a found item quickly so staff can contact the owner.
examples.zh: 捡到东西要尽快「上交拾获物品」，工作人员好联系失主。

collocations: turn in a found item immediately
turn in a found item at the desk
encourage students to turn in found items

words.enDefinition: lost property nobody has collected after a set period

examples.en: Unclaimed items are donated to a local charity after sixty days.
examples.zh: 「无人认领的物品」六十天后会捐给当地慈善机构。

examples.en: The lost and found shelf is crowded with unclaimed items before breaks.
examples.zh: 假期前，失物招领架上堆满了「无人认领的物品」。

words.enDefinition: a small receipt proving you reported or retrieved an item

examples.en: Keep your claim ticket until you pick up your lost phone.
examples.zh: 取回丢失的手机之前，请保管好「认领凭证」。

examples.en: They gave me a claim ticket with a reference number on it.
examples.zh: 他们给了我一张写着编号的「认领凭证」。

words.enDefinition: evidence that a lost item actually belongs to you

examples.en: Bring proof of ownership like a photo of the serial number.
examples.zh: 认领时要带上序列号照片这类「所有权证明」。

examples.en: Without proof of ownership, the office cannot release the bike.
examples.zh: 没有「所有权证明」，办公室不能把自行车发还。

words.enDefinition: details about a lost object's look, brand, and contents

examples.en: A detailed item description helps staff match your claim faster.
examples.zh: 详细的「物品描述」能帮工作人员更快核对你的认领。

examples.en: The item description asked for color, brand, and any stickers.
examples.zh: 「物品描述」要求写明颜色、品牌以及有没有贴纸。

words.enDefinition: a giveaway pack of snacks and study supplies before finals

examples.en: The student union hands out an exam survival kit during finals week.
examples.zh: 期末周，学生会馆会发放「考试加油包」。

examples.en: My exam survival kit had earplugs, granola bars, and a highlighter.
examples.zh: 我的「考试加油包」里有耳塞、燕麦棒和荧光笔。

collocations: pick up an exam survival kit
an exam survival kit with snacks

words.enDefinition: a boxed gift of snacks and comforts sent from home

examples.en: Student services mailed care packages to students staying on campus over the break.
examples.zh: 假期留校的学生，都收到了学生服务处寄来的「关怀包裹」。

examples.en: My parents sent a care package with instant noodles and winter gloves.
examples.zh: 父母寄来一个「关怀包裹」，里面有泡面和冬手套。

words.enDefinition: a planned short rest that keeps long study sessions sustainable

examples.en: The union hosts a study break with free hot chocolate at eight.
examples.zh: 八点学生会馆举办「学习间歇」活动，提供免费热巧克力。

examples.en: Take a study break every ninety minutes to stay focused.
examples.zh: 每九十分钟安排一次「学习间歇」，能帮你保持专注。

words.enDefinition: a calm, certified dog brought to campus to comfort students

examples.en: Therapy dogs visit the library on the last day of finals.
examples.zh: 期末最后一天，图书馆会有「治疗犬」互动活动。

examples.en: Petting a therapy dog for ten minutes lowered my stress before the exam.
examples.zh: 考试前撸了十分钟「治疗犬」，我的压力小多了。

words.enDefinition: a relaxed campus activity that helps students unwind before exams

examples.en: The counseling center runs a de-stress event with games before finals.
examples.zh: 期末前，咨询中心会举办带游戏的「减压活动」。

examples.en: The de-stress event included chair massages and a coloring station.
examples.zh: 这次「减压活动」有椅上按摩和涂色角落。

words.enDefinition: a room open all night for studying during busy weeks

examples.en: The 24-hour study space in the union requires swipe access after midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜之后进入学生会馆的「24小时自习空间」需要刷卡。

examples.en: Find a 24-hour study space early; they fill up fast in finals week.
examples.zh: 早点找好「24小时自习空间」，期末周很快就满座。

words.enDefinition: a campus service offering free groceries to students in need

examples.en: The campus food bank opens every Thursday behind the student center.
examples.zh: 校园「食物银行」每周四在学生中心后面开放。

examples.en: No one checks your income at the food bank; just bring a bag.
examples.zh: 去「食物银行」不查收入，带个袋子去就行。

words.enDefinition: not having reliable access to enough affordable, healthy food

examples.en: Food insecurity is common among students who pay rent first.
examples.zh: 先交房租的学生，常常面临「食物短缺」的困扰。

examples.en: The survey showed that food insecurity rises right before tuition is due.
examples.zh: 调查显示，交学费前夕「食物短缺」问题会加重。

words.enDefinition: a campus collection event gathering goods for students in need

examples.en: The donation drive collects canned food outside the dining hall.
examples.zh: 「捐赠活动」在食堂门口收集罐头食品。

examples.en: Our dorm won the donation drive with four hundred canned goods.
examples.zh: 我们宿舍楼捐了四百件罐头，赢了这次「捐赠活动」。

words.enDefinition: food that keeps for months without refrigeration, like canned goods

examples.en: Bring non-perishable items like rice, pasta, or canned beans to the drive.
examples.zh: 参加捐赠时，请带大米、意面或罐装豆类等「耐储存食品」。

examples.en: Check the wish list online before donating any non-perishable items.
examples.zh: 捐「耐储存食品」之前，先看一看需求清单。

words.enDefinition: an organized pairing of new students with experienced student guides

examples.en: The peer mentor program pairs new first-year students with upperclassmen.
examples.zh: 「同伴导师项目」让大一新生和高年级学生结对。

examples.en: Apply to the peer mentor program at the start of fall semester.
examples.zh: 秋季学期开学时，就可以申请「同伴导师项目」。

collocations: apply to the peer mentor program

words.enDefinition: the student who receives guidance in a mentoring pair

examples.en: As a mentee, you set the agenda for each monthly meeting.
examples.zh: 作为「受导学生」，每月见面的议题由你来定。

examples.en: Mentees who ask specific questions get much more out of the program.
examples.zh: 会提具体问题的「受导学生」，从项目中收获要多得多。

collocations: match a mentee with a mentor

words.enDefinition: a student whose parents never attended university themselves

examples.en: As a first-generation student, she learned the enrollment system alone.
examples.zh: 作为「第一代大学生」，她独自摸索选课系统。

examples.en: First-generation students can also join a free transition workshop series.
examples.zh: 「第一代大学生」可以参加免费的过渡系列工作坊。

words.enDefinition: a staff advisor helping students plan studies and campus life

examples.en: My success coach helped me balance a part-time job with coursework.
examples.zh: 「成功教练」帮我平衡兼职和课业。

examples.en: Book a success coach session through the student services portal.
examples.zh: 通过学生服务门户，预约一次「成功教练」面谈。

words.enDefinition: a summer program preparing incoming students before freshman year

examples.en: The bridge program starts three weeks before regular classes begin.
examples.zh: 「衔接项目」在正式开课前三周开始。

examples.en: Bridge program participants move in early and earn three credits.
examples.zh: 参加「衔接项目」的学生提前到校，还能修三个学分。

words.enDefinition: a service supporting students in disputes with university offices

examples.en: Student advocacy helped me when my scholarship was suddenly cancelled.
examples.zh: 奖学金突然被取消时，「学生权益服务」帮了我大忙。

examples.en: The student advocacy office explains your rights in plain language.
examples.zh: 「学生权益服务处」会用平实的语言解释你的权利。

words.enDefinition: a trained staff member who speaks up for students in disputes

examples.en: A student advocate sat with me during the meeting with housing.
examples.zh: 和住宿部门开会时，一位「学生权益顾问」陪在我身边。

examples.en: The student advocate can review your complaint letter before you send it.
examples.zh: 投诉信寄出前，「学生权益顾问」可以帮你把关。

words.enDefinition: a staff member coordinating all support for one student's situation

examples.en: The case manager coordinated all my support after a hospital stay.
examples.zh: 住院回来后，「个案管理员」统筹了我所有的支持安排。

examples.en: Your case manager follows up until every request is resolved.
examples.zh: 「个案管理员」会持续跟进，直到每个请求都解决。

collocations: your case manager will follow up

words.enDefinition: money the university gives students facing sudden financial crises

examples.en: The hardship fund covered my rent after my job fell through.
examples.zh: 工作落空之后，「困难补助基金」帮我付了房租。

examples.en: Apply to the hardship fund online; decisions take about a week.
examples.zh: 在线申请「困难补助基金」，大约一周就能出结果。

words.enDefinition: one-time money for sudden costs that grants do not cover

examples.en: An emergency grant covered my dental work when savings ran out.
examples.zh: 存款见底时，一笔「应急补助金」付了我的牙科费用。

examples.en: Emergency grants usually do not have to be repaid afterward.
examples.zh: 「应急补助金」通常不需要偿还。

collocations: an emergency grant for medical costs

words.enDefinition: a small short-term loan for urgent financial gaps

examples.en: The university offers an emergency loan of up to five hundred dollars.
examples.zh: 学校提供最高五百美元的「应急贷款」。

examples.en: I repaid my emergency loan at the cashier's window by June.
examples.zh: 六月之前，我在出纳窗口还清了「应急贷款」。

words.enDefinition: the official step-by-step process for reporting a problem

examples.en: The complaint procedure is explained step by step on the website.
examples.zh: 网站上一步一步说明了「投诉流程」。

examples.en: Follow the complaint procedure before posting about the issue online.
examples.zh: 在网上发帖吐槽之前，先按「投诉流程」来。

collocations: the complaint procedure takes two weeks

words.enDefinition: send a formal report about a service problem through official channels

examples.en: Submit a complaint through the online form and keep the reference number.
examples.zh: 通过在线表格「提交投诉」，并保存好查询编号。

examples.en: You can submit a complaint anonymously, but staff cannot reply to you.
examples.zh: 可以匿名「提交投诉」，但工作人员就没法回复你了。

collocations: submit a complaint within ten days

words.enDefinition: a short questionnaire rating a service after you use it

examples.en: Fill in the short feedback form after your appointment ends.
examples.zh: 预约结束后，请填写简短的「意见反馈表」。

examples.en: The feedback form takes two minutes and always stays anonymous.
examples.zh: 「意见反馈表」两分钟就能填完，而且是匿名的。

words.enDefinition: a box or online form collecting ideas from students

examples.en: Drop your ideas in the suggestion box outside the union office.
examples.zh: 把想法投进学生会办公室外的「意见箱」。

examples.en: The suggestion box led to a new evening shuttle route.
examples.zh: 「意见箱」里的一条建议，促成了新增的夜间班车路线。

collocations: post a note in the suggestion box
